full_judgment: 14. Mr. Samad further submits that the arrear of house rent is liability for the company for which an application under sections 162 and 163 of, the Companies Act is maintainable. It is upto the petitioner to choose the forum of relief. He has referred to a case of Bangladesh Road Transport Corporation Vs. M/s Ashraf Jute Mills Ltd. reported in BLD 1990 page 144. In that decision it is held by this Court that an arrear house rent is the liability of a company and if a company is unable to pay such liability it may be wound up. In the circumstances stated above the aforesaid decision is applicable in the present case. I have gone through the application, affidavit-in-opposition and affidavit-in-reply and other affidavits filed by the parties.
